description: This file defines formatting and output operators for various tensor-related types in the ATen core library of PyTorch, including Scalar and Tensor, as well as some deprecated types.

methods.name: operator<<(std::ostream&, Backend)
methods.description: Outputs a string representation of Backend enum to the stream.

methods.name: operator<<(std::ostream&, const Scalar&)
methods.description: Outputs a Scalar object to the stream.

methods.name: toString(const Scalar&)
methods.description: Converts a Scalar object to its string representation.

methods.name: operator<<(std::ostream&, const DeprecatedTypeProperties&)
methods.description: Outputs a DeprecatedTypeProperties object to the stream.

methods.name: print(std::ostream&, const Tensor&, int64_t)
methods.description: Prints the tensor with specified line size.

methods.name: operator<<(std::ostream&, const Tensor&)
methods.description: Inline operator to print a tensor with a default line size of 80.

methods.name: print(const Tensor&, int64_t)
methods.description: Prints the tensor with default line size 80.

ctags.name: operator <<
ctags.pattern: /^inline std::ostream& operator<<(std::ostream & out, const Tensor & t) {$/
